hypotheses.B0_bidegree_recomposition_is_exact: The MLP-count by attention-count grid through total degree 24 recomposes the direct gradient with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 at every site.
hypotheses.B1_both_operator_families_are_material: MLP-only and attention-only axes each have median gradient cosine below 0.90.
hypotheses.B2_cross_family_paths_are_necessary: The union of pure MLP and pure attention axes has median gradient cosine below 0.80.
hypotheses.B3_eight_by_eight_rectangle_is_sufficien: Keeping paths with at most eight MLP and eight attention responses reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.B4_four_by_four_rectangle_is_insufficien: The four-by-four rectangle has median gradient cosine below 0.80.
hypotheses.B5_eight_by_eight_preserves_sparse_lever: Its top-64 positive support retains at least 80% of exact first-order leverage in the median.
